evals.prompt: Please run wiki-lint on the wiki at `<TARGET_WIKI>`. Severity: all. The wiki is a freshly-bootstrapped sandbox with one source ingested (the fixture-happy-path-2025 source from the wiki-ingest evals). I want the full report.
evals.expected_output: Report saved to <TARGET_WIKI>/_lint/report-<today>.md. Citation coverage 100% (no missing-citation). Broken-citation 0, stale-claim 0, table-as-prose 0. Warnings: 1 flat-index probably no (index is short), 0 unresolved-contradiction, some unindexed-page and orphan-page on the entities just ingested are plausible — what matters is that the report is structurally correct, with all eight section headings present.
expectations: <TARGET_WIKI>/_lint/report-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md was created with today's date

The report has all eight category headings (missing-citation, broken-citation, stale-claim, table-as-prose, orphan-page, unresolved-contradiction, flat-index, unindexed-page); empty sections say `_None._`
The report's Summary block shows `critical: 0` (a freshly-ingested clean wiki should have zero critical findings)
The report has a `## Per-page summary` table
The report contains a `Citation coverage:` line
wiki-lint did NOT modify any wiki content (only wrote into _lint/ and possibly appended one log line)

evals.prompt: Please run wiki-lint on the wiki at `<TARGET_WIKI>`. Severity: all. This wiki was set up with intentional defects across all eight lint categories — I want to see if the skill catches each. Full report.
evals.expected_output: Report saved to <TARGET_WIKI>/_lint/report-<today>.md. Counts: at least one finding in each of the eight categories. Citation coverage < 100%. The summary should match the per-page table.
expectations: <TARGET_WIKI>/_lint/report-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md was created
missing-citation count ≥ 1 (the latency-3ms sentence on entities/entity-missing-citation.md)
broken-citation count ≥ 2 (one for §nonexistent-section, one for the nonexistent source-id on entities/entity-broken-citation.md)
stale-claim count ≥ 1 (entities/entity-stale.md edition 2024 vs source edition 2025)
table-as-prose count ≥ 1 (the 5-number paragraph on entities/entity-table-as-prose.md)
orphan-page count ≥ 1 (entities/entity-orphan.md)
unresolved-contradiction count ≥ 1 (contradictions/unresolved-fixture.md)
flat-index count = 1 (index.md exceeds 100 lines without sub-sections)
unindexed-page count ≥ 2 (entity-orphan.md AND entity-unindexed.md are both absent from index.md)
Summary critical-count and warning-count match the per-category sums in the body
Per-page summary table is present and sums match Summary

evals.prompt: Please run wiki-lint on the real `wikis/context-engineering/` wiki at `<TARGET_WIKI>`. This is a real ingest from yesterday — one source (Karpathy LLM Wiki gist), 2 entities, 5 concepts. I want to see the actual state. Full report.
evals.expected_output: Honest report on the real wiki. Counts unknown ahead of time — the eval grades whether the report is structurally correct and whether the skill terminated cleanly, not specific finding counts.
expectations: <TARGET_WIKI>/_lint/report-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md was created on the real wiki
Report has all eight category headings present
Report has a Citation coverage line with a real percentage (not N/A — the wiki has facts)
Report has a Per-page summary table covering ≥ 7 wiki pages (1 source + 2 entities + 5 concepts at minimum, may include the index/log if scanned)
wikis/context-engineering/raw/ was NOT scanned (immutable, excluded by Step 1)
wiki content (sources/, entities/, concepts/) was NOT modified — only _lint/ added and possibly one log.md line appended
